notes.title: Multiplayer Update- New & Improved!
notes.notes:
Homebrew Vehicle Sandbox- Multiplayer Update

As some of you may have noticed, we've been running three consecutive servers instead of one, all of which are a lot faster than the previous one we were running a couple of days ago. This is very good news for everyone who wants to play multiplayer!

What We Did

We started researching headless servers, and the possibilities of using those in Homebrew  (for those of you who don't know, a headless server is basically a terminal or command prompt, running a server. Instead of an actual game. Think Dedicated server software!), the big issue is, Homebrew 13 is not build for headless servers at all. We require the main camera, we require all scripts, just to make sure data is getting through correctly, or that data is being applied correctly. So we tried a lot of stuff, and came up with a "near-headless-server setup".

Basically we've got Homebrew running without a level, in the smallest resolution we could (QVGA. So 320x240) this means that having the game open, requires close to no CPU and GPU. Which is great! Cause servers usually don't have dedicated GPUs.. This means that everything will be running on the CPU. With the regular Homebrew, that means 99.9% CPU most of the time. The new server setup is about 8% CPU on idle. So we've been able to pump out a lot more with speed.

The downside is, if someone spawns a vehicle in Homebrew, the physics will be calculated on the Server side. Until someone enters that vehicle. This normally isn't an issue, but when a server doesn't have a dedicated GPU for physics calculations. That's an entirely different story.

Thankfully it doesn't spike That high. We're running 3 servers currently, mostly because we're unsure how many we can run on one machine in this setup. We'll might start up a couple more, or stop one of the servers, depending on the data of the servers. So far they seem to be working just fine though! So the chance of us closing one is pretty small.

http://i1124.photobucket.com/albums/l576/sgtbarnz/9AFDFF8684B125CBE8254DF7DDBC48CA06A23C1623A615F054pimgpsh_fullsize_distr_zps6sxht0rh.jpg

What Does This All Mean?

Servers are back, and they're faster than ever. It's still not perfect though. This also means that the server code will change immensely in Homebrew 14. Multiplayer will be mostly rewritten, some systems will stay (like the vehicle cloud-uploads.), but most will change, especially with headless servers in mind.

The goal would be having a simple terminal application, that's low in size, doesn't need a lot of CPU or RAM, and can just run on any virtual machine, with remote access available (either through some sort of ssh-tunnel, or through the game), as well as easy configurable settings (like part limits, game-mode selection, etc.) and upnp. We'll most likely won't be able to implement all of this when the Update is out, but we'll have temporary solutions until then.

notes.title: Quick patch 22/04/'15
notes.notes:
While working on the bigger update we decided to make some changes and fix some issues of the current build.

Helicopter rotorblades

Rotorblades now can use throttle up, throttle down and/or an axis:
This means that you'll be able to raise and lower the static RPM of the rotorblade and then increase/decrease this RPM with the axis.

You can adjust stabilizing_effect property to have more/less stabilizing force form a helicopter rotorblade
a value of 1 will make the rotorblade behave as normally expected 
a value of 0 will make the rotor behave like a plane propeller

Steer_speed property

This new property allows you to determine how fast the wheel will turn:
a value of 1 = maximum turning speed
a value of 0 = minimal turning speed

Wings

Wings now can handle 2 inputs at the same time which means that you can now hookup AxisA AND AxisB and blend them together. This will certainly come in handy when you attempt to build flying winged planes (tailless fixed wing aircraft)

Other fixes
Added full-screen support for monitors
Changed jet engine weight (both small and big) so that it's more accurate
Curve/sphere plates convex collider: fixed collision with terrain
Corrected the misaligned flap of the tapered vertical stunt plane wing
Fixed hovercraft propeller invert input property
Fixed autorefresh for the server list
Fixed load game problems

notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/H1BQLnr.jpg

After the latest update there were some issues with multiplayer. Therefore we decided to ensure that some of them are resolved by making additional changes.

Main changes
To resolve the most common problems we decided that it is best to eliminate direct vehicle transfer between players. This means that when you spawn a vehicle, it'll be uploaded to our server before it is passed on to other players.

You'll also notice that your vehicles will disappear every time a new player joins the server. We did this to ensure that nobody receives outdated data and we hope to have an update with a fix for this somewhere next week.

Click on Party in the main menu
Click on Browse
Click on the search icon to find the existing servers
Select the server you want to join and enter the password (if any)
Click on Join

To connect via LAN make sure you're signed in and follow these steps:

Click on Party in the main menu
Click on Browse
Fill in the IP-address of the host under direct join 
Click on Join

Hosting a server
In some cases hosting a server will require port-forwarding, if you're new to this, make sure to visit this site.

Click on Party in the main menu
Click on Host 
Choose the desired settings 
Click on Host

We did get a lot of requests for parts that can be used as plating however and we've noticed an increase in vehicles where parts are used as plating. Therefore we added a few pre-made armor plates that can be found in the parts browser.

Have a look at these screenshots to get a better idea of what to expect.

http://i.imgur.com/aj7EjGI.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/uKWbBTj.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/yiGSbkv.jpg

Currently the only included material is steel; it'll add weight to your creation and affect its behavior, but it will certainly protect your vital parts in combat. As you can see, the parts can be used both as 'plating' and armor at the same time. Once the final system is in place however, using them mainly for additional armor instead of cosmetics.

http://i.imgur.com/SV30U7S.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/H04tiBY.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/8xzFmiA.jpg

New demo

As of today an up to date demo version is available on Steam. It has a bunch of new features and supports cross-play with the pre-alpha owners. Soon you'll be able to read more about the changes we've made on our website

notes.title: Winter special update
notes.notes:
Since it'll be Christmas and new year soon, we thought that this would be a great moment for an update and some gifts from us. Now let's have a look at what winter brings us this year:

Full sandbox mode
Like most of you probably know, the orbs were a temporary solution that  gave us some extra time to fix bugs and see how the game evolved. 

There has always been a way to get 'infinite" orbs (all praise Tesla for that), but we think that now the time is right to turn Homebrew into a full sandbox. 

Here's the stuff we changed to achieve this goal: 

Removed orbs
Removed warehouse
Reworked world tutorial
Changed save game structure
...

World
We were working on the optimization of the level and we started thinking about how we can give the world a more seasonal feel. Some of the changes that are listed below will remain for a long time while others (like snow for example) will be removed later on.

These are the biggest changes to the world:

Changed summer theme to winter
Added more roads and fixed/replaced old ones
Added snow + ice
Updated valley mountains
Made changes inside the dome
Added anti-lag level (type 123 no lag for me in chat to enable/disable it)
...

http://i.imgur.com/iRjNLHY.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/Aj4B9iG.jpg

Race tracks are here!
We've added multiple race tracks that are scattered around the world. This is just a small fraction of what we have in mind for the challenge editor in the future.

http://i.imgur.com/POdN3Gz.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/zzUokZL.jpg

New parts
We received a lot of awesome ideas from the community and this quickly resulted in a long wishlist :). We'll be releasing a lot more parts in the future and some of the suggestions will definitely be included.

Here are the parts for this update:

Fireworks
Burst rockets
VTOL tilt rotor


http://i.imgur.com/XuXW5dO.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/WqgaFLR.jpg

Bug and other fixes
We're still amazed about how much feedback we've received from our community. You guys helped us find and solve bugs faster and although we're still working on some of them, Homebrew gets a bit better every day. 

Here are the fixes in this update:

Fixed browning bug
Fixed rename bug
Fixed lights on water bug
Fixed electric motor bug: reverse gear should work fine now
Fixed some minor bugs
Fixed some text
...


Meet Joe
There was one important character missing so far, it was the mechanic named Joe and he is the other owner of the JOEDAN workshop. Just like Danny he has his own story to tell and you'll discover more about them further into development. 

For now however, Joe just wants to hang out and make some friends. 

http://i.imgur.com/GSDx31G.png
http://i.imgur.com/hu4o89o.png

Other changes

Added sounds
Added music
Added new third person camera mode
Reworked tutorial texts
Added invert_input property to propellers and other
You can now set tree distance to 0
Made changes to the pyramid ;)
Added force direction indicators
Added invert property to all axis-controllable
Cube scans vehicles in workshop
Added new default vehicles
Added new secret
Optimization
...
